intent: The passage states the claim outright, so the suggestion should cite it and not invent a second source.

chapter.title: Literature review
chapter.scopeNote: What is known about household adoption barriers, and where the evidence thins out.

passages.text: In a 2021 survey of 312 rural households in Karnataka, upfront cost was reported as the main barrier to rooftop solar adoption, ahead of awareness and roof suitability.
Wind turbine siting decisions in coastal Kerala were dominated by grid connection distance rather than measured wind speed.
Bottom-up sectoral mitigation potentials were assessed across regions using a common accounting framework.
